entities.summary: The RheinMain University of Applied Sciences, formerly University of Applied Sciences Wiesbaden, is a university located in Wiesbaden, Germany, founded in 1971. It is part of the IT-Cluster Rhine-Main-Neckar, the "Silicon Valley of Europe".
